summary: Follow phone inventories and detect dropped collections sockets from protocol heartbeats

replay.detail: Existing graph admission and recovery are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema or projection version changes.

compatibility.detail: The phone selects optional inventory-collections version 1 for clients, usage, machines, devices, native sessions and terminal lists. Older daemons retain HTTP reads on focus and explicit pull, with a Fleet note; automatic inventory timers are removed. Usage period fields are now typed in the generated TypeScript subscription filters. Shipping iOS builds add a SocketRocket adapter that exposes existing protocol pings; Expo Go lacks that native heartbeat callback and cannot detect a silent socket until its transport ends.

downtime.detail: No daemon replacement is required beyond the already optional inventory collection support.

manual.detail: A normal native iOS build autolinks the new StCollections module; pairing credentials and user settings remain usable.

recovery.detail: Three missed eight-second heartbeats close a foreground socket and use the existing reconnect delays and offline wording. Backgrounding closes the socket; reconnect and explicit refresh receive authoritative snapshots. Screen subscriptions share slots and leave after the existing thirty-second grace.
